name: verifycloud
description: CI/CD, regression testing, coverage, and AI-assisted debugging for RTL

scripts.build: npm run build -w @verifycloud/shared && npm run build -w @verifycloud/server && npm run build -w @verifycloud/worker && npm run build -w @verifycloud/cli && npm run build -w @verifycloud/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server packages/worker packages/cli && npm run typecheck -w @verifycloud/web
